Spacecraft name AragoSat-1
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status cancelled
Organization Institut Polytechnique des Sciences Avancées (IPSA)
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Headquarters France
Oneliner

Test miniature Helicon RF (Radio Frequency) thruster.

Description

Mission is to prove the functioning of a non-restrictive propulsion system capable of compensating for the atmospheric drag of the CubeSats. For this, we are developing it in partnership with the ICARE laboratory of the CNRS with the electric propulsion team led by Mr. Stéphane Mazouffre.

It is a miniature Helicon RF (Radio Frequency) thruster capable of reaching the objective with an input power of less than 15W.
